summary: This note covers the origin of the song "The Climb," recorded by Miley Cyrus for the film Hannah Montana: The Movie. Director Peter Chelsom found the song in Nashville, Tennessee, after it had been rejected by several country artists, and asked songwriters Jessi Alexander and Jon Mabe to rework it from third person to first person. After several drafts the writers produced a version they considered perfect for the movie. The note also gives the single's release details, including its release date, genre, length, label, songwriters and producer.
one_line: Origin and release details of "The Climb," the Miley Cyrus single written by Jessi Alexander and Jon Mabe for Hannah Montana: The Movie.
key_facts: The song "The Climb" had been rejected by several country artists before Miley Cyrus recorded it.
Director Peter Chelsom picked up the song and gave it to Miley Cyrus to record for Hannah Montana: The Movie.
Peter Chelsom found the song while visiting Nashville, Tennessee, during a quest to find eleven new songs for Hannah Montana: The Movie.
Chelsom asked Jessi Alexander to submit songs for consideration after hearing her music in Nashville.
Jessi Alexander recorded "It's the Climb" on a CD and gave it to Chelsom.
Chelsom called Alexander several weeks later to say the song "was gon na be an integral part of the movie."
Chelsom asked Mabe and Alexander to rework some content and change the song from third person to first person.
Alexander said that for her, changing third person to first person "can change the whole meaning of a line."
Alexander and Jon Mabe "wrestled over taking words out" while trying to keep the song's integrity.
After a number of drafts, Mabe and Alexander created a version they felt was "perfect for the movie."
"The Climb" was released as a single on February 21, 2009.
The song was recorded in 2008 and has a length of 3:56.
The single's genre is country pop and its label is Hollywood.
The songwriters are Jessi Alexander and Jon Mabe, and the producer is John Shanks.
The song appears on the album Hannah Montana: The Movie and The Time of Our Lives (International Edition).
